snippet.title: Killest Fights CRAW-Mech Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Killest has Arrived! 

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500410/Killest_Fights_CRAWMech

Main Trailer: https://youtu.be/LQWNkmd5JyI?si=UYv0TS7ML2mcLvM-

Killest Fights CRAW-Mech is officially out now on Steam! It’ll be 40% off for the first 2 weeks! 

Special thanks for the illustrations by Taylor Evans: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNUXw7Yv-EjYK_kYLfUxdHg

And score by Chris “Doug” London: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYlcX_V3CIQY91MNgm8Mo8A
